Dealer Opportunity

A New Cash Sales Opportunity for Sleep Therapy Customers

BongoRx gives dealers a compact, clinically tested, FDA-cleared sleep apnea therapy option for patients with mild to moderate OSA who may not want, tolerate, or afford a traditional CPAP setup.

Ideal Patient Profile

Newly diagnosed mild to moderate OSA patients, CPAP non-compliant patients, travelers, and patients facing high deductibles or co-payments.

No Power Required

Uses the patient’s own exhalation to create EPAP, helping keep the airway open without a machine or electricity.

Simple Starter Kit

The Four Sizes Starter Kit allows easy contactless setup with multiple sizes, headgear, travel case, and drying stand.

Sleep Apnea Therapy anytime, anwhere

The New Rhythm in Sleep

Bongo Rx was designed for patients with mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea (OSA): Newly diagnosed without significant co-morbidities to use as a first line sleep apnea therapy option. Unable to get a CPAP, do not qualify for CPAP, or cannot afford CPAP because of high deductibles, or high co-payments. No longer using their CPAP and looking for a user-friendly alternative. Using their CPAP, but need a device to use while traveling, camping, or any time electricity may not be available.

How It Works

Small, simple, and built for real-world use.

BongoRx has soft nasal seals that dilate the nasal passages. During inhalation, small valves open so the patient can breathe normally. During exhalation, valves close and direct air through vent holes to generate EPAP.

  • Clinically tested for mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea
  • FDA-cleared CPAP alternative with history of use
  • Use at home, traveling, camping, or when electricity is unavailable
  • No assembly required and easy to clean
  • Expiratory Positive Airway Pressure (EPAP) of 4–8 mmHg (or cmH2O)
Clinically tested • FDA-cleared

Clinically proven EPAP therapy — no machine, hose, or power.

In a clinical study by Alan Lankford, PhD and Jerrold Kram, MD, the Bongo Rx reduced mean AHI from 15.7 to 7.1 — a 45% reduction (p=0.0093) — with an 83% patient acceptance rate and no serious adverse events. It uses the patient's own exhalation to generate EPAP and keep the airway open.

  • FDA-cleared for mild-to-moderate obstructive sleep apnea
  • CPAP alternative — freedom from machines, hoses, and power
  • Four-size starter kit for easy, contactless fit at home
  • Replenishment packs drive recurring resupply revenue
  • Proudly designed and made in the USA

BongoRx Countertop Display

Hands On Introduction EPAP

The BongoRx countertop display gives customers an approachable, hands-on introduction to EPAP therapy. By allowing them to see the compact nasal dilators, examine the carrying case, and take home educational materials, the display helps make a new therapy option easier to understand. Its compact design communicates the primary benefits of BongoRx at the point of sale: no machine, mask, hose, electricity, or batteries. The display also gives staff a natural opportunity to start conversations with appropriate patients seeking a portable and discreet prescription therapy option for mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea. Placed near the checkout counter, CPAP department, or sleep-therapy consultation area, the BongoRx display can help:

  • Encourage customer questions and staff interaction
  • Demonstrate the product’s small, travel-friendly design
  • Explain how EPAP uses the patient’s own exhaled breath to create therapeutic pressure
  • Support at-home sizing with the multi-size starter kit
  • Increase awareness of an alternative to traditional machine-based therapy
BongoRx makes EPAP therapy something customers can see, touch, understand, and discuss with a knowledgeable provider.

Dealer FAQ

Common questions to answer during the meeting

Does BongoRx need a prescription?

Yes. Sleep apnea treatment devices require a prescription in the United States. An existing PAP therapy prescription on file may qualify.

Is BongoRx reimbursed by insurance?

BongoRx is generally not a covered item under medical insurance plans. Patients may be able to use FSA/HSA funds because it is a prescription device.

What should every new patient start with?

New patients should start with BNG500, the Four Sizes Starter Kit, to determine the preferred size at home.

What are the key patient benefits?

Freedom from machines, hoses, and power; small and discreet; useful at home or while traveling; quick startup; simple use; no assembly; easy to clean.
